sentences: This monumental canvas shows Parisians at leisure on an island in the Seine.
Seurat did not mix colors on the palette; he set small dots of pure color side by side so that they blend in the viewer's eye.
This technique, pointillism, was an experiment grounded in the color science of his day.
He spent nearly two years on dozens of studies, calculating the place of every figure, so unlike spontaneous Impressionism, the scene is frozen and sculptural.
Puzzling details hide in it, like a woman walking a monkey on a leash and another quietly fishing.
He even repainted a border of dots around the edge, enclosing the picture in its own frame.
